**TL;DR:** Added multi-round recursive STM per the paper's perfection-rounds idea (stm.py [rounds] arg; pool reset each round, floor quantile tightened 0.25/0.20/0.15 via new round_config, optimizer carried across rounds; commit accd37b). 3-round run from step_00007630 (runs/20260610_210039): champion overall 60.41 (rank 16/36), efficiency 10.04 (rank 6/36), wiki ppl 4.609, blimp 60.28, arc 34.40. Beats baseline 58.31, single-round STM 59.62, and the previous all-time best scores.md row (60.40/10.03).

**Long description:** Per-round raw gains (end-of-round checkpoints, overall score): start 57.70 -> round 1 58.91 (+1.21) -> round 2 59.39 (+0.48) -> round 3 59.96 (+0.57). Diminishing but non-vanishing returns, matching the paper's gen-1/2/3 pattern. Round-2 circling culled the most samples (112,621 survivors vs 116,069 in round 1), echoing the paper's Re-Circle event; round 3's tighter floor culled slightly less (113,944). Round 3's end checkpoint alone hit efficiency rank 8/36 before any merging; the tournament champion (gen2_gen0_step_00009430+step_00009030@t0.50+gen1_gen0_step_00009430+step_00009130@t0.35+step_00009430@t0.65@t0.33, all round-3 STM checkpoints) lifted it to rank 6. Implementation: StmConfig gained floor_tighten_per_round (0.05) and floor_quantile_min (0.05); round_config derives per-round config with shifted seed; stm_phase loops rounds with step naming base+100*(round_offset+epoch). 3 proving tests for round_config written first; 151 tests pass, lint/pyaot clean.

**What worked:** Everything end to end, exit 0. Round-1 trajectory differed slightly from the earlier single-round run (58.91 vs 58.77 at step_00008230) — benchmark noise (~±0.4 ARC documented 2026-06-10 20:20) plus identical seed but same data; within noise.

**What failed:** Nothing.

**What was kept / discarded:** Kept rounds support, tests, docs entries, run dir, scores.md row. Nothing discarded.

**Open questions / next steps:** Round 4+ untested — per-round gains were still ~+0.5 at round 3, so a 4th round might still pay. Floor tightening schedule (linear 0.05) untuned. Recursive STM on a fresh 2B run (rather than the 1B baseline) untested.
